name: Wangxiang Zheng: Deliver Me
source:
A name which is lost, a piece of memory which is forgotten.
The girl is missing her mind in the paranoia, while the demon is around her.
She asks for the forgiven after being betrayed.
Then the song of love and hate is being sacrified.

The story is about one girl named Lingluo who is trying her best to pursue the music dream. She lost her best friends and her confidence, then she was locked inside her own imaginations. Finally, she fought against her 'Paranoia Personality' bravely and escaped from the Paranoia world. She came back to the real life and rebuild the dream. Of course, she also met her best friend with happiness at the end.

[Edited form [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/779640/]Steam[/url]]

Visual novel adaptation of the novel inspired by the Chinese Vocaloid series [url=https://zh.moegirl.org/%E5%A6%84%E6%83%B3%E7%97%87Paranoia%E7%B3%BB%E5%88%97]Paranoia[/url].
